editorial_intro: This week brings a fresh lineup of Indian content to streaming platforms, including the highly anticipated crime drama 'Daayra' on Netflix and the thrilling series 'Haiwaan' on JioHotstar. Don't miss out on these exciting new releases!

picks.title: Daayra
picks.synopsis: In 'Daayra', a gripping crime drama directed by Meghna Gulzar, a determined police officer, played by Kareena Kapoor Khan, investigates a series of brutal murders that lead her into the dark underbelly of society. As she delves deeper, she uncovers a web of corruption and betrayal that challenges her moral compass and personal relationships.
picks.why_watch: This film promises a powerful performance from Kareena Kapoor Khan and a compelling narrative that keeps you on the edge of your seat. It's a must-watch for fans of intense crime dramas.

picks.title: Adhey Neevu Adhey Nenu
picks.synopsis: Adhey Neevu Adhey Nenu is an Indian Telugu-language romantic crime thriller film directed by Kondal, and produced by Kandregula Govindu under Sri Lakshmi Veerabhadra Creations banner. The film stars Trinadh Varma, Yashwanth Pendyala, Tanvi Negi, and Sahar Krishnan.
picks.why_watch: With a heartfelt storyline and strong performances, this film is sure to resonate with anyone who believes in the power of love and second chances.

picks.title: Meesaya Murukku 2
picks.synopsis: In this sequel, the protagonist returns to his roots and faces new challenges in the music industry while trying to balance his personal life. The film showcases the struggles of aspiring musicians and the importance of family support.
picks.why_watch: This film combines music and drama beautifully, making it a delightful watch for fans of Tamil cinema and music lovers alike.
